title: AI Functions Unity Catalog permissions is now generally available
body: AI Functions Unity Catalog permissions is now [generally available](/aws/en/release-notes/release-types). Metastore admins can use Unity Catalog permissions on the `system.ai` schema to control which task-specific AI Functions users in your organization can run. Contact your Databricks account team to enable this feature. See [AI Functions Unity Catalog permissions](/aws/en/large-language-models/ai-functions-uc-permissions).
